original_evidence.result: The property perChatGhostModeString reads wg_perChatGhost. Parsing splits on comma, trims CharacterSet.whitespaces and converts signed decimal Int64 values; semicolons and whitespace inside a token are not separators.

original_evidence.contract: Local read and network receipt gates differ
original_evidence.result: Global/per-chat ghost blocks automatic local reads, with an explicit action exception. disableReadReceipts alone does not block the local read. Network suppression for disableReadReceipts/global/per-chat ghost precedes the readOnAction exception. The recovered implementation carries a one-use account/peer/thread/index permit instead of the original global pending byte.

Reasons are lowercased. child_abuse, child_pornography, csae and csam are never bypassed by this policy. pornography, tos_violation, apple and age_restriction are bypassed even when the broad switch is off. Other reasons follow bypassContentRestrictions, whose missing-value fallback is true.
original_evidence.regression: tests/privacy/test_original_contracts.py decodes both original static Swift string arrays and compares the production sets.

original_evidence.result: The verified avatar handler prompts when suggestGhostForStories is true and disableStoryReadReceipts is false. The enable callback writes the latter flag, then invokes the bound opening closure. It does not enable global ghost mode.

ghostModeRecordOnce supplies the view-once argument to sending. saveViewOnceMedia has a real opening consumer selecting image representations and video/instant-video or video MIME resources. Audio is retained as a local file by this port, not exported as a Photos asset.

LocationMapNode reads fakeLocationEnabled/fakeLat/fakeLon for currentUserLocation, didLoad and didUpdate. Only (0,0), not either zero axis alone, means unset. This evidence does not establish a raw GPS or live-broadcast override.

The original helper is specific to a kicked channel. At the channel transition, shouldDismiss is the inverse of keepBannedChats. Legacy group removal and secret-chat termination are separate branches.

wg_fakeDeviceName getter/setter and UI editor are established. The bounded all-image direct-call/string-reference queries did not establish its MTProto API-environment consumer. No device-name runtime implementation is claimed.

implementation_scopes.readOnAction: Bound visible incoming index at a successful local enqueue or reaction. Account, peer, namespace and thread cannot widen or reuse the permit. Ghost/explicit receipt suppression still wins. Scheduled/custom/preview/support contexts are excluded; no read-all or story/content receipt is authorized by this exception.
implementation_scopes.localContent: Protected local copy/text selection/file export/gallery save and capture-protection consumers, text/media spoiler rendering, reason-specific restricted content, cached kicked-channel retention/read-only presentation.
implementation_scopes.retainedMedia: Incoming downloaded timed/view-once image/video/voice resources, captured before consumption or when the normal viewer download completes. Account-local retained copies and a browser/export/delete UI. View-once images/videos can be saved through Photos with explicit authorization and persisted success identifiers.
implementation_scopes.recordOnce: Immediate and draft voice sends and video-message camera sends; excludes scheduled messages, bots, self-chat, non-cloud users and paid-message contexts through target eligibility checks. Voice postprocessing remains active.

defaults_and_schema.storage: WhitegramSettingsState.v1 canonical JSON takes precedence over wg_* primitive mirrors. Reads do not rewrite imported values. Boolean/number readers reject Boolean-number coercion.
defaults_and_schema.perChatGhost: String, default empty. Comma-separated signed PeerId.toInt64 values, globally scoped as in the original primitive. Explicit toggles serialize a sorted unique list and mirror wg_perChatGhost.
defaults_and_schema.coordinates: fakeLat/fakeLon are finite Double values in -90...90 and -180...180, default 0.0. Only both zero is unset. The picker commits both in one preference update and does not implicitly enable the switch.
parent_schema_actions: Add perChatGhost as a string archive rule and accept its wg_perChatGhost primitive spelling. It is absent from the inspected shared schema. A bounded archive size such as 65536 bytes is a port limit, not a recovered original limit.
Add suggestGhostForStories as a Boolean archive rule, default false. It is absent from the inspected shared schema.
fakeLocationEnabled, fakeLat, fakeLon and ghostModeRecordOnce already have shared archive rules; the coordinate picker uses those exact keys.
The original perChatGhostModeString property name must not replace the real perChatGhost storage key.
